sources.title: Visa-on-Arrival in Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Special Branch guidance confirms border issuance mechanics but limits availability to specified nationalities and conditional mission-absence, invitation, origin and official routes; it does not provide a safe residual complement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: not all countries offer this facility, and those that do, offer it to citizens of specific countries under certain conditions.

sources.title: Bangladesh MRV Visa Application
sources.publisher: Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government MRV service requires a printed form to be taken with documents and payment to a visa office or mission. It is a filing workflow, not a nationality eligibility or electronic-issuance schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Take the printed form enclosed with required documents, payment of visa fees documents to the nearest Visa office / Bangladesh Mission.

sources.title: Isenção de Visto para São Tomé e Príncipe

sources.title: Ghana Passport Services: Visa-free countries

sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ghana MFA passport service displays a country table with separate Ordinary, Service and Diplomatic columns and 90-day maximum duration; its São Tomé and Príncipe ordinary entry corroborates the reciprocal visitor baseline.

policies.title: Ghanaian ordinary passports: São Tomé and Príncipe visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The live São Toméan SMF notice names Ghana for a cooperation-agreement visa exemption of up to 90 days, corroborated by Ghana MFA's current ordinary-passport 90-day waiver register.
conditions: Applies to Ghanaian ordinary passports for a short visitor stay of up to 90 days. The SMF notice states entry remains subject to a passport valid for at least three months, sufficient funds and return/onward evidence.
It does not establish work, residence, transit, diplomatic, service, official, crew or final-admission treatment.
